referenceFunction.generalComment: The data represent an example of a SMT mounting line – comprising 3 small component placing machines, 2 big components placing machines, 1 inspection device and 1 reflow oven. Total weight data are taken from producer information of such machines. Composition, infrastructure and production efforts are based on own assumptions. The dataset represents a production line with a total weight of 19’300 kg. ICT dataset updates in 2023 were included in the inventory; UUID: 09943bd3-7019-3055-ab9f-a78eb2fd1750
referenceFunction.includedProcesses: This module includes material, production efforts (material treatment processes), transport efforts and the infrastructure for the production of all the machineries used for the mouning of surface mount components onto a printed wiring board. No information about emissions (air, water) and waste are included.
